name: model-probe-http
summary: Same-origin HTTP probe used by the Models Settings page to measure LLM reachability and latency.
rationale: This is not a DSH tool seam. The caller is this plugin's Settings UI. The Host streams a capped eight-token request, which can incur a provider charge, so the route must not be callable from another origin or from a request that only sets a static header.

requiredHeaders.origin: http(s) origin whose host equals the Host header

request.provider: llm-pi-ai provider route id, for example volcengine
request.model: exact model id on that route

response.ok: true on a finished stream, false on 403/502
response.timeToFirstTokenMs: optional time to first text or reasoning delta
response.error: present when ok is false; never includes credential values

cost: One provider request capped at eight output tokens. Settings copy must warn before the user clicks Test.
